note: The two sets are identical on 15 claims; Set A adds one further claim, a 3 1/2" steel rod diameter with a verbatim quote, which reads as a genuine drawing keynote rather than an invention. Both sets share the same weaknesses: three duplicated facts (Teflon plate, column cap plate, threaded rod each stated twice, differing only by a trailing 'in'), a trivial grade-level datum, and a bolt quote whose leading 'W(2)' is garbled. Since the shared claims are equal, the extra supported claim makes Set A the stronger extraction, while Set B omits that fact.
remarks: The supplied image shows only the empty GENERAL SHEET NOTES / REFERENCE KEYNOTES / SHEET KEYNOTES table boxes, and the text layer contains only those headings, so none of the quoted keynotes (Teflon plate, neoprene pad, W10X15, steel rod, etc.) can be verified against the visible part of the page; they appear to originate from the drawing portion shown in part 1.
